targetQuery: N/A — /white-label is a noindex B2B sales page for a paid subscription product, not an organic acquisition target. It is reached from cold outreach email and from the branded demo links inside those emails, and is deliberately excluded from the sitemap.
evidenceSource: N/A — no keyword research applies because the page does not compete for rankings and carries robots: noindex, follow. Demand for the underlying product was validated separately against live competitor pricing: VaultRubric sells white-label financial calculators to banks and credit unions at $200–$1,000/month, rebel Ai sells a mortgage calculator widget with lead capture at $29/month, and SumWize and FinCalc both gate white-label embeds behind paid plans. That establishes both the price floor and the willingness to pay.

gscEvidence.currentRankingUrl: N/A — page is noindex by design

serpIntent: N/A — there is no SERP intent to match. The page is only ever reached from an outreach email or a demo link, so its job is transactional: show the product, show the price, remove the objection, and offer a branded preview before payment.
competitorWeakness: N/A for SERP. Commercially the gap is verifiable: VaultRubric offers a handful of plain-English calculators at $200–$1,000/month, rebel Ai sells a single mortgage widget at $29/month, and the unpaid WordPress plugins that dominate install counts capture no leads at all — their own competitors advertise that they 'generate $0'. Nobody in the category ships a complete library, and QFINHUB already has 129 formula-verified calculators.
pageTypeDecision: New static app route at /white-label — a sales/conversion page for a subscription product, functionally equivalent to the other excluded company pages (/services, /demo). Not a calculator, blog post, guide, comparison, or scenario page.
